description: Read a full OpenTrain proposal/candidate evaluation by proposal id: status, bid, masked candidate, AI-interview score + summary, location/identity verification, Open Label assessment, the application-stage screening standing (`screening`: LMS course + quiz status, grade state, finalized percentage/pass, course-version currency, and the `proposal:<jobOfferId>` enrollment key for the LMS review/grade/release/decide tools; `screeningRead` FAILED means unknown right now, not "not enrolled"), and contract state. Pass includeInterview: true to also fetch the sanitized AI-interview transcript. Requires proposals:read scope and preserves OpenTrain proposal privacy restrictions.

includeInterview.description: Set true to also fetch the sanitized AI-interview transcript (interviewer/candidate messages) for deeper candidate evaluation.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal/job offer id to read.

name: opentrain_get_proposal
